title: CCTV & Security Systems
shortDesc: A CCTV system, or closed-circuit television, consists of a network of strategically placed cameras, designed to record and capture footage at key points – entryways, secure rooms and things of that nature.
longDesc:
At Topform Technologies, we provide state-of-the-art CCTV and video surveillance solutions tailored to businesses and residences across the UAE. Our systems are designed to deter criminal activity, gather evidence, and give you 24/7 peace of mind.

We supply, install, and maintain top-brand IP cameras, HD analog systems, and NVR/DVR recording infrastructure. From a single-camera home setup to a multi-site enterprise network, we deliver scalable solutions that grow with you.

title: Door Access & TNA Systems
shortDesc: As a company expands, security takes on greater significance. Traditionally, door locks have been used to provide access to the office or building, We also offer electronic access control with sliding and swing doors.
longDesc:
Topform Technologies delivers comprehensive electronic access control and Time & Attendance (TNA) solutions for businesses of all sizes in Dubai and the wider UAE. Replace traditional locks with smart, auditable systems that tell you exactly who entered — and when.

Our TNA solutions integrate seamlessly with payroll software, eliminating manual timesheets and reducing errors. We support fingerprint, face recognition, RFID card, and PIN-based systems.
whyUs: We are authorized dealers for leading brands and offer professional installation, training, and annual maintenance contracts to ensure round-the-clock security.

shortDesc: One technology that's commonly employed in the telecom sector is IP PBX. Another name for it is IP-PBX, or IP-based private branch exchange. It is regarded as the replacement for older phone systems.
longDesc:
Topform Technologies supplies and installs modern PABX and IP-PBX telephone systems that keep your team connected — whether in-office, remote, or on the move. We help businesses upgrade from legacy phone lines to powerful, cloud-capable VoIP infrastructure.

Our solutions support internal extensions, auto-attendants, call recording, conference bridges, and CRM integration, giving your business a professional telephony setup at a fraction of the traditional cost.
whyUs: With decades of telecom experience, our engineers design systems that scale from 5 to 500 extensions, with minimal downtime during migration from legacy systems.
